title: Front Cover
content: The African clawed frog (Xenopus laevis), caught in a pond in western France where it has become invasive. The cover image relates to Research Article “Invasion dynamics of the alien amphibian Xenopus laevis in France: perspectives for management” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70000] by Pagano et al. Photo credit: Julien Morin.
